protocol: DAVE v1 MLS suite 0x0002 and Opus audio frame encryption
runtime: Python standard library plus the already embedded pure ecdsa 0.19.2 and tlslite-ng 0.8.2 sources; no native code, process, package installation, or runtime network fetch
implemented: P-256 DHKEM/HKDF-SHA256/AES-128-GCM HPKE base mode and DER ECDSA-SHA256

MLS TLS encoding, KeyPackage and leaf signatures, parent hashes, complete ratchet-tree authentication, external sender proposals, proposal references/revocation, member commits and Welcome, TreeKEM, epoch confirmation, PSK scheduling, exporter
davey Session lifecycle consumed by discord.py: pending/awaiting/active, reinit, epoch transitions, user media key derivation, verification fingerprints and privacy codes

DAVE Opus framing with eight-byte AES-GCM tags, ULEB128 nonce, authenticated ranges on receive, ratchet generation, replay/out-of-order protection, ten-second epoch grace, explicitly negotiated passthrough expiry

tests.native_session_interop: Original Rust davey Session and Python Session exchanged Welcome, Commit, Remove, self UpdatePath and frame ciphertexts; original A and C plus Python B agreed on exporters through epochs 1–4
tests.native_oracle: Built only in ignored cache with the original pinned dependency lock (removed sdist-absent NAPI workspace entries without changing any retained version/checksum); visibility-only instrumentation exposes original frame cryptor and a nonce setter for boundary fixtures; no compiled oracle is shipped
tests.native_nested_rtp: Valid Opus from native libopus 1.3.1, original Rust davey Session and libsodium 1.0.18 produce exact inner AES-GCM frame and outer XChaCha20-Poly1305 RTP bytes in both directions.
tests.sdk_consumer: Original discord.py VoiceClient, VoiceConnectionState and DiscordVoiceWebSocket over an owned TLS WebSocket plus actual UDP SocketReader/VoiceReceiver: KeyPackage/Welcome/transition/proposals/CommitWelcome/own commit, authenticated payload and user identity, replay/MAC/plaintext refusal, invalid commit recovery. The Opus decoder remains a separately reported codec boundary.
tests.negotiated_passthrough: Original gateway prepare/downgrade/execute/upgrade messages enable passthrough; authentication errors never trigger a plaintext fallback in the qualified adapter.
tests.member_removal: Original native Session refuses an incoming Commit that evicts itself; the qualified Session drops retained media keys, refuses frames and signals the original SDK reinitialization path.

limits: This is the concrete Hermes Discord Opus consumer, not a general-purpose MLS implementation: encrypted MLS PrivateMessage, external commits, ReInit/branch transitions and other cipher suites are rejected.
DAVE video codec packetizer transforms are not implemented.
Python scalar/AES operations do not provide constant-time secret arithmetic.
Live Discord infrastructure and bot credentials are not required by, or exercised in, the deterministic fixture suite. Live service credentials are kept outside fixture tests.
Bounds: 16 MiB MLS messages, 4096 MLS leaves, 1 MiB media frames, 128 retained KeyPackages; an exhausted key-package bound explicitly requires reinitialization.
